name: Anna Julianna Pfeiffer

events.place: Przystajnia, Kalisz Powiat, Warsaw Governorate, Congress Poland

notes: Family History Centre: Refer to LDS Record # 9 and 10 from film # 764031.  In these records, Anna Julianna Pfeiffer was shown to be born on Jan.23,and Feb. 11 of 1848 reflecting the Julian and Gregorian dates.  Father is shown to be Martin Pfeiffer aged 28 in 1849 which implies that he was born in 1821 and that corresonds to the record we have for Martin Pfeiffer, BK # 1721.  The mother is shown on this record to be Dorothy ?oser which we think is Koser.  There may be a discrepancy here about how old Dorothy was in 1849.  The interpreter indicated 25 but, according to the other date we have for her, she should be 28, but that may simply be interpretation.  Witnesses appear to be Gottlieba Dohnke 33, and, Christina Pfeiffer 20.
